titulo.alumno: An explanation in the past · What had happened before

intro: Part 2: an explanation in the past. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: Use the Danish past perfect «havde/var + participle» to mark an action that happened before another past moment. The auxiliary depends on the verb and the meaning; learn the common uses in context.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

frases.estudio: Bussen var kørt, da vi nåede stoppestedet.
frases.alumno: The bus had left when we reached the stop.

frases.estudio: Vi havde misforstået den nye køreplan.
frases.alumno: We had misunderstood the new timetable.
